blocks.title: Patch surface: a site each against one tenant-aware app
Which layers a request reaches
blocks.lede: 2% of requests reach the core; the rest stop at the edge or the cache.

blocks.title: Requests reaching each layer, per 100 entering
blocks.alt: A beam of 100 requests entering at the left narrows as it passes through the edge, the cache and the application, so that only 2 reach the core.
